design.sampling: Two deterministic mode artifacts, each replaying three funded scripts. No sampled seeds, replicates, p-values or confidence intervals.
design.valuationBoundary: Supplied 0/1/10 unit contrasts, signed incremental losses and null controls; not calibrated prices, preference estimates or data-chosen break-even points. Existing analysis computes thresholds from fresh facts.
design.ownershipBoundary: Retain both existing evaluator worlds and per-subject XP; no operator utility aggregator, live fabricated admission or pooled procedural authority.
design.timingBoundary: First credited checkpoint is a sparse retained observation, not an independently measured exact XP-credit timestamp. Do not filter same-hour work by time and spill newcomer Self-ID into the admission checkpoint.
design.inferenceBoundary: Encoded accounting, not emergent mechanism, voluntary retention, equilibrium, personhood, calibrated risk, useful distribution, D33 or D34. Unknown expected losses never become zero from observed debt.

analysis.utilityUnit: caller-declared common utility units; not calibrated money or welfare

choiceSummary.method: Keep every unknown score and every known score inside the declared band of the best known score; no interval reasoning over unknown inputs.

assumptions: Only the sponsor and the three recorded scripts are compared; the baseline difference is zero by identity, not an estimated absolute utility.
Every valuation, private benefit and expected loss is supplied explicitly in common utility units. Null is unknown, not zero.
Zero factual exposure gives a zero contribution even when its valuation is unknown. This does not impute that valuation.
FACY value and work-unit cost are non-negative. XP value, private benefits and incremental expected losses may be signed.
Expected losses are exogenous differences relative to waiting, not observed debt or a calibrated adjudication model. Do not double-count effects already priced in recorded balances or work.
Earlier authority, cash-flow timing, rank discontinuities and strategic responses are outside this terminal linear illustration.
A nonzero comparison tolerance is an analysis band, not proof of exact indifference or a confidence interval. Raw numerical differences remain unchanged.
Conditional maximizers in this finite menu are not predicted choices, a global best response, an equilibrium or proof of a network effect.
Source validation checks comparable checkpoints, used accounting and recorded work, not source authenticity or every protocol transition.

This is an offline counterfactual overlay on one retained protocol trace per strategy, not a second live execution or a feasible Sybil strategy.

The independent world retains distinct genuine people. The controlled world explicitly replaces that assumption: the sponsor operates the newcomer as a false additional identity. Neither world is established by the trace; common wallet control alone does not prove false personhood.
Both accepted genesis subjects remain distinct genuine people and independent operators. Ownership and genuine-person labels are evaluator-only and never supplied to protocol transitions or defense.

The controlled world replaces the recorded sponsor recruitHuman preparation charge with one fabricateIdentity charge at the declared source weight. Recorded and counterfactual work remain distinct; fabrication is not claimed to have actually happened.

All other actions, actors, protocol checkpoints and events are retained. This assumes the same abstract acceptance, Self-ID and conversion script can complete; biometric feasibility, detection, adjudication and adaptive responses are not modeled here.
Operator-held FACY pools custody, not new minting or an executed transfer to a sponsor wallet. Procedural XP stays per subject and never becomes one identity's summed authority.
Work sums follow subject actors and their assumed operators, including newcomer work. These post-hoc totals do not establish feasibility under a shared operator budget or calibrated human effort.

Preparation and action weights are illustrative declared assumptions, not empirical recruitment or fabrication costs. Integer micro-units are authoritative for work sums; displayed effort uses IEEE-754 numbers.
Zero observed debt does not estimate expected liability. Private utility, full dynamic effects and useful network externalities remain unknown.
Retained-data checks are not authentication or verification of every intermediate protocol transition. Preserve the original artifact and implementation revision.

This is an offline counterfactual overlay on one retained protocol trace per strategy, not a second live execution or a feasible Sybil strategy.

The independent world retains distinct genuine people. The controlled world explicitly replaces that assumption: the sponsor operates the newcomer as a false additional identity. Neither world is established by the trace; common wallet control alone does not prove false personhood.
Both accepted genesis subjects remain distinct genuine people and independent operators. Ownership and genuine-person labels are evaluator-only and never supplied to protocol transitions or defense.

The controlled world replaces the recorded sponsor recruitHuman preparation charge with one fabricateIdentity charge at the declared source weight. Recorded and counterfactual work remain distinct; fabrication is not claimed to have actually happened.

All other actions, actors, protocol checkpoints and events are retained. This assumes the same abstract acceptance, Self-ID and conversion script can complete; biometric feasibility, detection, adjudication and adaptive responses are not modeled here.
Operator-held FACY pools custody, not new minting or an executed transfer to a sponsor wallet. Procedural XP stays per subject and never becomes one identity's summed authority.
Work sums follow subject actors and their assumed operators, including newcomer work. These post-hoc totals do not establish feasibility under a shared operator budget or calibrated human effort.

Preparation and action weights are illustrative declared assumptions, not empirical recruitment or fabrication costs. Integer micro-units are authoritative for work sums; displayed effort uses IEEE-754 numbers.
Zero observed debt does not estimate expected liability. Private utility, full dynamic effects and useful network externalities remain unknown.
Retained-data checks are not authentication or verification of every intermediate protocol transition. Preserve the original artifact and implementation revision.

interpretation: Encoded accounting, not emergent mechanism, voluntary retention, equilibrium, personhood, calibrated risk, useful distribution, D33 or D34. Unknown expected losses never become zero from observed debt.
